rows.text: “智能”一词被中国古代的思想家们认为是智慧和能力的总称，最早出现在《荀子·正名篇》：“所以知之在人者谓之知，知有所合谓之智。所以能之在人者谓之能，能有所合谓之能”。在这里，“智”可以理解为认识活动的心理特点，“能”可以理解为实践活动的心理特点。根据霍华德·加德纳的多元智能理论，智能可以分为七个范畴，即语言、逻辑、空间、肢体运作、音乐、人际、内省。所以根据当前人工智能的发展，除了内省人工智能设备无法达到，其他六项内容均可实现。

rows.text: To evaluate post-hoc refinement in high-granularity regimes, we introduce two diagnostics: topic dispersion, which measures distributional bal-ance and penalises mega-topics more heavily than niche ones, and topic discriminability, which mea-sures how well a topic’s representation aligns with its assigned documents relative to non-assigned documents. Across two patent corpora and a legal corpus, we find that 83% of high-similarity topic pairs are rejected as non-redundant by the LLM. EGIM improves topic discriminability by 25–55% over an iterative LLM baseline while preserving over 94% of original topic dispersion across all three corpora, compared to 34–88% for the base-line.

rows.text: We apply our evaluation pipeline to two corpora of 15 recent astrophysics arXiv preprints and 15 ML preprints, benchmarking SKEPTHICAL alongside eleven additional reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, and three publicly available external AI reviewers (the Stanford Agentic Reviewer [16], OpenReviewer-8B [8], and the PaperAudit-Bench detector [20]). To our knowledge, our application to the astrophysics corpus is the first controlled comparison of AI peer-reviewer systems on a real, non-ML scientific paper corpus. We release the evaluation pipeline, together with the paper lists, injection catalogues, and full adjudication logs, as a public benchmark at github.com/inigozubeldia/skepthical-benchmark.
